question: Is our webhook still disabled? If so, please turn it back on.

model.source: recorded from openai/gpt-oss-120b through the openai provider

replies.text: Your workspace still has one webhook disabled (ID wh_31c9) and the other active [obs:1]. Only workspace admins can reactivate a disabled webhook; you’ll need to ask an admin to go to **Settings → Integrations → Webhooks** and enable it again [help:webhooks@2#0]. If you’re the admin, you can simply toggle the status back to “active.” Otherwise, have an admin handle it.
